summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host and install metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: Package @ecg-internal/reviews-dialog-ui@1.0.0 is a functionality-free shim whose main module exports a Proxy of no-op functions. Its only real behavior is a beacon in beacon.cjs that POSTs JSON containing the package name, os.hostname(), the absolute install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the Node.js version to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon is invoked both from the declared postinstall script and from index.js at require/import time, so metadata is exfiltrated on every `npm install` and on every load of the package. The @ecg-internal/ scope, the `Compatibility shim.` description, the absence of any real code, and the hardcoded phone-home to a bare IP over plain HTTP are the canonical shape of a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal organization scope; installer-side disclosure includes hostname, install path, working directory, and runtime version to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
